title: Root-zone soil wetness
source: NASA GMAO Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2
definition: The amount of water and water vapor available to plants in the root zone, generally considered to be the upper 1 m of soil, expressed as the proportion of water present in a given amount of soil. Values range from 0 for completely dry conditions to 1 for completely saturated soil.
